label: bug
file: src/notifications/rollup.ts

The issue is a bug where the weekly summary email for Monday arrives on Tuesday for some users, depending on their time zone. The email sending is handled by the weekly rollup feature located in `src/notifications/rollup.ts`, which sends the weekly rollup on Monday at 08:00 in each user's own time zone. The problem likely relates to how user time zones are handled or how the sending time is calculated for different time zones (e.g., Sydney vs London). This file is the most relevant locus to investigate and fix the scheduling and time zone handling for the weekly rollup email.
